headline: Weathered Expanse Works Shift; Nevish Line Stirs Again
war_summary: The lines have moved again since the afternoon edition. In Weathered Expanse one more work has lapsed into no-man's-land, leaving the Colonials four of nine, the Wardens one, and four unclaimed; eighty-eight events were logged there on the day and twenty-one within six hours, while the latest hour's ledger shows 998 Colonial and 2,007 Warden casualties. Mooring County stands unchanged at ten Warden works against two Colonial, its forty-eight events of the day now quiet for two hours. Callahan's Passage holds at ten Warden works, three events in the last two hours and 1,212 Colonial against 1,260 Warden casualties in the latest hour. Nevish Line, now seven Warden works to one Colonial, has stirred after its morning lull with six events in two hours. Gutter logged six events inside two hours at Kuoppa, and Marban Hollow saw a Warden capture at Mox at the hour of filing. Across 436 works the Colonials hold 307, the Wardens 123, and six lie unclaimed; thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
